# LinkedIn Similar Companies

> Send one LinkedIn company URL. You get lookalike companies: name, description, location, and URL.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Starting from $0.45 per 1,000 source companies.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-similar-companies
- Call: `oday/mawsool-linkedin-similar-companies`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Use it when

You have a customer and you want companies that resemble them.

## Use something else when

You already have the lookalike URLs and you need firmographics. Use Firmographics or Company Details.

## Page

- Find companies similar to a LinkedIn company: docs/similar-linkedin-companies.md

Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
